draft.title: 一起UNO！
draft.playNote: 经典的四人UNO桌面卡牌游戏，支持与小手机内的AI角色或同伴一同游玩。包含红黄蓝绿四色数字牌、跳过(Skip)、转向(Reverse)、罚摸两张(Draw 2)、变色(Wild)与罚摸四张(Wild Draw 4)全套规则。游戏进入后自适应横屏显示，支持出剩1张牌时喊UNO、AI对手性格打牌台词互动，并在对局结束时自动生成战局总结写入角色记忆。

<!doctype html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=1.0, user-scalable=no, viewport-fit=cover">
  <title>四人UNO对决</title>
  <style>
    * {
      box-sizing: border-box;
      user-select: none;
      -webkit-user-select: none;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
    }

    html, body {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      overflow: hidden;
      background: #0f172a;
      font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
      color: #fff;
    }

    /* 强制横屏自适应旋转容器 */
    #orient-wrapper {
      position: absolute;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      overflow: hidden;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      background: radial-gradient(circle at center, #1e293b 0%, #090d16 100%);
    }

    /* 牌桌区域 */
    .table-container {
      position: relative;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-rows: 72px 1fr 125px;
      grid-template-columns: 140px 1fr 140px;
      padding: 8px 16px;
    }

    /* 玩家席位卡片 */
    .player-seat {
      position: relative;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      padding: 6px 10px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.07);
      border-radius: 14px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
      backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
      transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
      z-index: 10;
    }

    .player-seat.active-turn {
      background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.24);
      border-color: #f59e0b;
      box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.6), inset 0 0 10px rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.3);
      transform: scale(1.05);
      animation: turnPulse 1.6s infinite alternate ease-in-out;
    }

    @keyframes turnPulse {
      0% { box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.4); }
      100% { box-shadow: 0 0 26px rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.75), 0 0 8px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6); }
    }

    .seat-top {
      grid-row: 1;
      grid-column: 2;
      justify-self: center;
      align-self: start;
    }

    .seat-left {
      grid-row: 2;
      grid-column: 1;
      justify-self: start;
      align-self: center;
      flex-direction: column;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .seat-right {
      grid-row: 2;
      grid-column: 3;
      justify-self: end;
      align-self: center;
      flex-direction: column;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .seat-bottom {
      grid-row: 3;
      grid-column: 1 / span 3;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      padding: 0 4px 4px 4px;
      min-width: 0;
      width: 100%;
      height: 120px;
      overflow: hidden;
      box-sizing: border-box;
    }

    .avatar-wrapper {
      position: relative;
      width: 46px;
      height: 46px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      overflow: visible; /* 保证外部徽章绝不被裁剪 */
      transition: transform 0.15s;
    }

    /* 牌桌所有席位头像均支持点击做出互动与情绪表达 */
    .player-seat .avatar-wrapper {
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .player-seat .avatar-wrapper:hover {
      transform: scale(1.1);
    }

    .player-seat .avatar-wrapper:hover .avatar-box {
      border-color: #38bdf8;
      box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.5);
    }

    .player-seat .avatar-wrapper:active {
      transform: scale(0.95);
    }

    .avatar-box {
      position: relative;
      width: 44px;
      height: 44px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      border: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.4);
      overflow: hidden;
      background: #334155;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 18px;
      font-weight: bold;
    }

    .avatar-box img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: cover;
      display: block;
    }

    .uno-badge {
      position: absolute;
      top: -6px;
      right: -10px;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ef4444, #dc2626);
      color: #ffffff;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 900;
      font-style: italic;
      padding: 2px 6px;
      border-radius: 8px;
      border: 1.5px solid #fef08a;
      box-shadow: 0 3px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.6), 0 0 10px rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.6);
      animation: bounce 0.55s infinite alternate;
      display: none;
      z-index: 25;
      white-space: nowrap;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    @keyframes bounce {
      from { transform: translateY(0); }
      to { transform: translateY(-4px); }
    }

    .seat-info {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      max-width: 90px;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .seat-name {
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 600;
      white-space: nowrap;
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .seat-count {
      font-size: 11px;
      color: #94a3b8;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 4px;
    }

    .card-mini-icon {
      display: inline-block;
      width: 10px;
      height: 14px;
      background: #ef4444;
      border-radius: 2px;
      border: 1px solid #fff;
    }

    /* 对话/台词气泡 - 横向长方形设计 (带指向尾巴) */
    .speech-bubble {
      position: absolute;
      background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.96);
      color: #f8fafc;
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 600;
      line-height: 1.35;
      padding: 6px 14px;
      border-radius: 6px; /* 规整硬朗的横向长方形 */
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.28);
      box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6), 0 0 10px rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.22);
      pointer-events: none;
      opacity: 0;
      transition: opacity 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1);
      z-index: 60;
      min-width: 90px;
      max-width: 250px;
      white-space: nowrap; /* 保持单行横向长方形延伸，绝不挤压变方 */
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
      overflow: visible;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
    }

    .speech-bubble.show {
      opacity: 1;
    }

    /* 上方对家：在头像正下方居中展开为横向长方形 */
    .seat-top .speech-bubble {
      top: calc(100% + 10px);
      left: 50%;
      transform: translateX(-50%) scale(0.92);
    }
    .seat-top .speech-bubble.show {
      transform: translateX(-50%) scale(1);
    }
    .seat-top .speech-bubble::before {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      top: -5px;
      left: 50%;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      border-left: 5px solid transparent;
      border-right: 5px solid transparent;
      border-bottom: 5px solid rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.96);
    }

    /* 左方玩家：向右侧中场横向长条展开 */
    .seat-left .speech-bubble {
      left: calc(100% + 12px);
      top: 50%;
      transform: translateY(-50%) scale(0.92);
    }
    .seat-left .speech-bubble.show {
      transform: translateY(-50%) scale(1);
    }
    .seat-left .speech-bubble::before {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      left: -5px;
      top: 50%;
      transform: translateY(-50%);
      border-top: 5px solid transparent;
      border-bottom: 5px solid transparent;
      border-right: 5px solid rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.96);
    }

    /* 右方玩家：向左侧中场横向长条展开 */
    .seat-right .speech-bubble {
      right: calc(100% + 12px);
      top: 50%;
      transform: translateY(-50%) scale(0.92);
    }
    .seat-right .speech-bubble.show {
      transform: translateY(-50%) scale(1);
    }
    .seat-right .speech-bubble::before {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      right: -5px;
      top: 50%;
      transform: translateY(-50%);
      border-top: 5px solid transparent;
      border-bottom: 5px solid transparent;
      border-left: 5px solid rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.96);
    }

    /* 下方玩家：在席位上方水平横向展开 */
    .seat-bottom .speech-bubble {
      left: 10px;
      bottom: calc(100% + 8px);
      transform: translateY(4px) scale(0.92);
    }
    .seat-bottom .speech-bubble.show {
      transform: translateY(0) scale(1);
    }
    .seat-bottom .speech-bubble::before {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      bottom: -5px;
      left: 20px;
      border-left: 5px solid transparent;
      border-right: 5px solid transparent;
      border-top: 5px solid rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.96);
    }

    /* 牌桌中央互动区 */
    .center-board {
      grid-row: 2;
      grid-column: 2;
      position: relative;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 28px;
    }

    /* 转向指示器环 */
    .direction-ring {
      position: absolute;
      width: 220px;
      height: 220px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      border: 2px dashed rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
      pointer-events: none;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      transition: transform 0.8s ease-in-out;
    }

    .direction-ring::before {
      content: "➔";
      position: absolute;
      top: -12px;
      font-size: 20px;
      color: #38bdf8;
      filter: drop-shadow(0 0 6px #38bdf8);
    }

    .direction-ring::after {
      content: "➔";
      position: absolute;
      bottom: -12px;
      font-size: 20px;
      color: #38bdf8;
      filter: drop-shadow(0 0 6px #38bdf8);
      transform: rotate(180deg);
    }

    .direction-ring.reverse {
      transform: scaleX(-1);
    }

    /* 当前有效颜色环形微光 */
    .active-color-glow {
      position: absolute;
      width: 140px;
      height: 140px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      filter: blur(28px);
      opacity: 0.45;
      pointer-events: none;
      transition: background 0.4s;
    }

    .color-red { background: #ef4444 !important; }
    .color-yellow { background: #eab308 !important; }
    .color-green { background: #22c55e !important; }
    .color-blue { background: #3b82f6 !important; }
    .color-black { background: #1e293b !important; }

    /* UNO 卡牌外观 */
    .uno-card {
      position: relative;
      width: 68px;
      height: 98px;
      border-radius: 9px;
      background: #ffffff;
      border: 3px solid #ffffff;
      box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      cursor: pointer;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      transition: transform 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1), box-shadow 0.18s;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .uno-card.playable:hover {
      transform: translateY(-14px) scale(1.08);
      box-shadow: 0 10px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.6), 0 0 14px rgba(255,255,255,0.7);
      z-index: 25;
    }

    .uno-card.playable {
      box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7);
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .uno-card.disabled {
      opacity: 0.55;
      filter: grayscale(0.2);
      cursor: not-allowed;
    }

    .card-inner {
      position: relative;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      border-radius: 6px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    /* 经典椭圆底饰 */
    .card-oval {
      position: absolute;
      width: 54px;
      height: 82px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      transform: rotate(26deg);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .card-num {
      position: relative;
      font-size: 32px;
      font-weight: 900;
      font-style: italic;
      color: #ffffff;
      text-shadow: 2px 2px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
      z-index: 2;
    }

    .card-corner {
      position: absolute;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: #fff;
      font-style: italic;
      z-index: 2;
    }

    .card-corner.tl { top: 2px; left: 4px; }
    .card-corner.br { bottom: 2px; right: 4px; transform: rotate(180deg); }

    /* 抽牌堆与弃牌堆 */
    .deck-pile {
      position: relative;
      width: 68px;
      height: 98px;
      border-radius: 9px;
      background: #0f172a;
      border: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.4);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      box-shadow: -4px 5px 0px #334155, -8px 10px 0px #1e293b;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: transform 0.15s;
    }

    .deck-pile:active {
      transform: scale(0.95);
    }

    .deck-logo {
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 900;
      color: #ef4444;
      text-shadow: 1px 1px 0 #fbbf24;
      font-style: italic;
    }

    .deck-count {
      font-size: 10px;
      color: #94a3b8;
      margin-top: 4px;
    }

    /* 手牌区域 (玩家) - 防止溢出与自适应重叠 */
    .player-hand-container {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      flex: 1;
      min-width: 0;
      height: 100%;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .hand-cards-scroll {
      flex: 1;
      min-width: 0;
      height: 100%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      overflow-x: auto;
      overflow-y: visible;
      padding: 24px 14px 6px 14px;
      scrollbar-width: thin;
      scrollbar-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.2) transparent;
      -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
    }

    .hand-cards-scroll::-webkit-scrollbar {
      height: 4px;
    }

    .hand-cards-scroll::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25);
      border-radius: 4px;
    }

    .hand-cards-scroll .card-wrapper {
      position: relative;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      transition: margin-right 0.25s ease, transform 0.2s ease, z-index 0.1s;
    }

    .hand-cards-scroll .card-wrapper:hover,
    .hand-cards-scroll .card-wrapper:focus-within,
    .hand-cards-scroll .card-wrapper.touch-active {
      z-index: 60 !important;
      transform: translateY(-16px) scale(1.14);
    }

    .hand-cards-scroll .card-wrapper:hover .uno-card,
    .hand-cards-scroll .card-wrapper.touch-active .uno-card {
      box-shadow: 0 14px 28px rgba(0,0,0,0.7), 0 0 16px rgba(255,255,255,0.8);
    }

    /* 玩家操作控制栏 */
    .player-controls {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 8px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .btn-uno {
      padding: 8px 14px;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ef4444, #b91c1c);
      color: #fff;
      font-weight: 900;
      font-size: 15px;
      font-style: italic;
      border: 2px solid #fef08a;
      border-radius: 20px;
      box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.5);
      cursor: pointer;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 4px;
      transition: all 0.2s;
    }

    .btn-uno:active {
      transform: scale(0.92);
    }

    .btn-uno.highlight {
      animation: pulse-uno 0.5s infinite alternate;
    }

    @keyframes pulse-uno {
      from { transform: scale(1); box-shadow: 0 0 10px #ef4444; }
      to { transform: scale(1.12); box-shadow: 0 0 20px #f59e0b, 0 0 30px #ef4444; }
    }

    .btn-pass {
      padding: 6px 12px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
      color: #e2e8f0;
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 600;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25);
      border-radius: 14px;
      cursor: pointer;
      display: none;
    }

    /* 席位互动表情弹出条 (基于相对定位，不受旋转影响) */
    .react-popover {
      position: absolute;
      background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.96);
      border: 1.5px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.5);
      border-radius: 30px;
      padding: 4px 8px;
      display: none;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.75), 0 0 16px rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.4);
      backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
      z-index: 140;
      animation: popIn 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1);
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .react-popover.show {
      display: flex;
    }

    /* 各席位相对锚定定位 */
    .seat-top .react-popover {
      top: calc(100% + 10px);
      left: 50%;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
    }

    .seat-left .react-popover {
      left: calc(100% + 10px);
      top: 50%;
      transform: translateY(-50%);
    }

    .seat-right .react-popover {
      right: calc(100% + 10px);
      top: 50%;
      transform: translateY(-50%);
    }

    .seat-bottom .react-popover {
      bottom: calc(100% + 10px);
      left: 10px;
    }

    .react-btn {
      width: 34px;
      height: 34px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 21px;
      cursor: pointer;
      border-radius: 50%;
      transition: transform 0.15s, background 0.15s;
    }

    .react-btn:hover {
      transform: scale(1.3);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18);
    }

    .react-btn:active {
      transform: scale(0.92);
    }

    /* 席位卡片增加轻触提示与微浮动反馈 */
    .player-seat {
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .player-seat:hover {
      border-color: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.6);
      box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.25);
    }

    /* 头像处绽放的互动表情大特效 */
    .burst-emoji {
      position: absolute;
      top: 50%;
      left: 50%;
      transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(0.2);
      font-size: 42px;
      pointer-events: none;
      z-index: 80;
      opacity: 0;
      animation: burstAnim 1.2s cubic-bezier(0.18, 0.89, 0.32, 1.28) forwards;
    }

    @keyframes burstAnim {
      0% { transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(0.2); opacity: 0; }
      25% { transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1.3); opacity: 1; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 12px rgba(255,255,255,0.8)); }
      60% { transform: translate(-50%, -65%) scale(1.05); opacity: 1; }
      100% { transform: translate(-50%, -85%) scale(0.8); opacity: 0; }
    }

    /* 选色浮层 */
    .color-picker-overlay {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: rgba(0,0,0,0.75);
      backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
      display: none;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      z-index: 100;
    }

    /* UNO +4 质疑弹窗 (Challenge Modal) */
    .challenge-modal-overlay {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: rgba(10, 15, 29, 0.88);
      backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
      display: none;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      z-index: 180;
      padding: 16px;
    }

    .challenge-modal-overlay.show {
      display: flex;
    }

    .challenge-card {
      background: #1e293b;
      border: 2px solid #ef4444;
      border-radius: 20px;
      padding: 18px 22px;
      max-width: 440px;
      width: 100%;
      text-align: center;
      box-shadow: 0 16px 36px rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.35);
      animation: popIn 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1);
    }

    .challenge-title {
      font-size: 18px;
      font-weight: 900;
      color: #f87171;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 6px;
    }

    .challenge-desc {
      font-size: 12px;
      line-height: 1.6;
      color: #cbd5e1;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
      background: rgba(0,0,0,0.25);
      padding: 10px 12px;
      border-radius: 10px;
      text-align: left;
    }

    .challenge-actions {
      display: flex;
      gap: 12px;
    }

    .btn-challenge-yes {
      flex: 1;
      padding: 10px 12px;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f59e0b, #d97706);
      color: #fff;
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 13px;
      border: none;
      border-radius: 12px;
      cursor: pointer;
      box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.4);
      transition: transform 0.15s;
    }

    .btn-challenge-no {
      flex: 1;
      padding: 10px 12px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25);
      color: #e2e8f0;
      font-weight: 700;

    /* =========================================================
       1. 自适应横屏逻辑 (竖屏时顺时针旋转90度填满屏幕，横屏时自然铺满)
       ========================================================= */
    function adaptOrientation() {
      const w = window.innerWidth;
      const h = window.innerHeight;
      const wrapper = document.getElementById('orient-wrapper');
      if (!wrapper) return;

      if (w < h) {
        // 竖屏：强制旋转 90 度模拟横屏
        wrapper.style.width = h + 'px';
        wrapper.style.height = w + 'px';
        wrapper.style.transformOrigin = '0 0';
        wrapper.style.transform = 'matrix(0, 1, -1, 0, ' + w + ', 0)';
      } else {
        // 已经是横屏
        wrapper.style.width = '100%';
        wrapper.style.height = '100%';
        wrapper.style.transformOrigin = 'center center';
        wrapper.style.transform = 'none';
      }
    }

    window.addEventListener('resize', adaptOrientation);
    window.addEventListener('orientationchange', adaptOrientation);
    adaptOrientation();

    // 尝试锁定横屏方向
    try {
      if (screen.orientation && screen.orientation.lock) {
        screen.orientation.lock('landscape').catch(() => {});
      }
    } catch(e) {}

    /* =========================================================
       2. Web Audio API 简易原生合成音效 (零 CDN 依赖)
       ========================================================= */
    let audioCtx = null;
    function getAudioContext() {
      if (!audioCtx) {
        audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
      }
      if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') {
        audioCtx.resume();
      }
      return audioCtx;
    }

    function playSound(type) {
      try {
        const ctx = getAudioContext();
        if (!ctx) return;
        const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
        const gain = ctx.createGain();
        osc.connect(gain);
        gain.connect(ctx.destination);

        const now = ctx.currentTime;
        if (type === 'play') {
          // 优雅清脆的出牌音
          osc.type = 'sine';
          osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(440, now);
          osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(880, now + 0.1);
          gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.15, now);
          gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.01, now + 0.12);
          osc.start(now);
          osc.stop(now + 0.12);
        } else if (type === 'draw') {
          // 摸牌滑纸声
          osc.type = 'triangle';
          osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(260, now);
          osc.frequency.linearRampToValueAtTime(180, now + 0.1);
          gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.12, now);
          gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.01, now + 0.1);
          osc.start(now);
          osc.stop(now + 0.1);
        } else if (type === 'uno') {
          // 激情报号音
          osc.type = 'square';
          osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(523.25, now); // C5
          osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(659.25, now + 0.08); // E5
          osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(783.99, now + 0.16); // G5
          gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.2, now);
          gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.01, now + 0.35);
          osc.start(now);
          osc.stop(now + 0.35);
        } else if (type === 'win') {
          // 胜利三连和弦
          [523.25, 659.25, 783.99, 1046.5].forEach((freq, i) => {
            const o = ctx.createOscillator();
            const g = ctx.createGain();
            o.connect(g);
            g.connect(ctx.destination);
            o.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, now + i * 0.1);
            g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.15, now + i * 0.1);
            g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, now + i * 0.1 + 0.4);
            o.start(now + i * 0.1);
            o.stop(now + i * 0.1 + 0.4);
          });
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    /* =========================================================
       3. UNO 牌库定义与洗牌引擎
       ========================================================= */
    const COLORS = ['red', 'yellow', 'green', 'blue'];
    const SPECIAL_TYPES = ['skip', 'reverse', 'draw2'];

    function createDeck() {
      const deck = [];
      let uid = 1;

      // 4 色数字牌与功能牌
      COLORS.forEach(color => {
        // 0 号牌每色 1 张
        deck.push({ id: uid++, color, type: 'number', value: 0 });
        // 1-9 号牌每色各 2 张
        for (let v = 1; v <= 9; v++) {
          deck.push({ id: uid++, color, type: 'number', value: v });
          deck.push({ id: uid++, color, type: 'number', value: v });
        }
        // 功能牌各 2 张
        SPECIAL_TYPES.forEach(type => {
          deck.push({ id: uid++, color, type, value: type });
          deck.push({ id: uid++, color, type, value: type });
        });
      });

      // 万能牌 (黑色)
      for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
        deck.push({ id: uid++, color: 'black', type: 'wild', value: 'W' });
        deck.push({ id: uid++, color: 'black', type: 'wild_draw4', value: '+4' });
      }

      // Fisher-Yates 洗牌
      for (let i = deck.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
        const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
        [deck[i], deck[j]] = [deck[j], deck[i]];
      }

      return deck;
    }

    // 手牌智能理牌：相同颜色的牌排在一起，同颜色内按数字与功能有序排列
    function sortCardsByColor(cards) {
      const colorOrder = { red: 0, yellow: 1, green: 2, blue: 3, black: 4 };
      const valOrder = { skip: 10, reverse: 11, draw2: 12, wild: 13, wild_draw4: 14 };

      return cards.slice().sort((a, b) => {
        if (colorOrder[a.color] !== colorOrder[b.color]) {
          return colorOrder[a.color] - colorOrder[b.color];
        }
        const valA = typeof a.value === 'number' ? a.value : (valOrder[a.value] || 20);
        const valB = typeof b.value === 'number' ? b.value : (valOrder[b.value] || 20);
        return valA - valB;
      });
    }

    let playerProfile = { name: "我", avatar: null };

    let selectedCharIds = [];

    // 初始化玩家数据：永久持久化头像支持 (本地 Storage + 宿主 saveGame/loadGame 双重备份)
    async function initHostServices() {
      let savedCustomAvatar = null;

      // 1. 优先从 LocalStorage 读取用户曾经上传保存过的头像
      try {
        savedCustomAvatar = localStorage.getItem('uno_user_permanent_avatar') || localStorage.getItem('aiphone_user_custom_avatar');
      } catch (e) {}

      // 2. 从宿主存档加载
      if (window.AiPhoneGame) {
        try {
          await AiPhoneGame.setTitleBar({
            buttonBackground: "rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.65)",
            buttonColor: "#38bdf8",
            buttonBorderColor: "rgba(255,255,255,0.18)",
            buttonRadius: "999px",
            iconOpacity: 0.95
          });
        } catch (e) {}

        try {
          const save = await AiPhoneGame.loadGame();
          if (save && save.customAvatar) {
            savedCustomAvatar = save.customAvatar;
          }
        } catch (e) {}

        try {
          const p = await AiPhoneGame.getPlayerProfile();
          if (p) {
            if (p.name) playerProfile.name = p.name;
            // 只有在用户尚未自主上传过头像时，才使用小手机默认头像
            if (!savedCustomAvatar) {
              const hostAvatar = p.avatar || p.avatarUrl || p.icon || p.image || p.headImg || p.photo;
              if (hostAvatar) playerProfile.avatar = hostAvatar;
            }
          }
        } catch (e) {}

        try {
          const list = await AiPhoneGame.listAvailableCharacters();
          if (Array.isArray(list)) availableChars = list;
        } catch (e) {}
      }

      // 如果用户曾经上传过专属头像，予以最高优先级永久锁定保留
      if (savedCustomAvatar) {
        playerProfile.avatar = savedCustomAvatar;
      }

      // 更新玩家自己形象预览与文件上传监听
      updateUserProfilePreview();
      bindAvatarUpload();
      renderCharSelection();
    }

    function updateUserProfilePreview() {
      const pName = document.getElementById('user-preview-name');
      const pImg = document.getElementById('user-preview-img');
      const pText = document.getElementById('user-preview-text');
      if (pName) pName.innerText = playerProfile.name;

      if (playerProfile.avatar) {
        if (pImg) {
          pImg.src = playerProfile.avatar;
          pImg.style.display = 'block';
        }
        if (pText) pText.style.display = 'none';
      } else {
        if (pImg) pImg.style.display = 'none';
        if (pText) {
          pText.innerText = (playerProfile.name || "我").slice(0, 1);
          pText.style.display = 'block';
        }
      }
    }

    function bindAvatarUpload() {
      const fileInput = document.getElementById('user-avatar-file-input');
      const clickBox = document.getElementById('user-avatar-click-box');
      const triggerBtn = document.getElementById('btn-upload-avatar-trigger');

      if (clickBox && fileInput) {
        clickBox.onclick = () => fileInput.click();
      }
      if (triggerBtn && fileInput) {
        triggerBtn.onclick = () => fileInput.click();
      }

      if (fileInput) {
        fileInput.onchange = (e) => {
          const file = e.target.files && e.target.files[0];
          if (!file) return;

          const reader = new FileReader();
          reader.onload = (event) => {
            const base64Url = event.target.result;
            playerProfile.avatar = base64Url;
            // 写入本地持久化
            try {
              localStorage.setItem('uno_user_permanent_avatar', base64Url);
              localStorage.setItem('aiphone_user_custom_avatar', base64Url);
            } catch (err) {}

            // 同时写入宿主小手机官方存档 saveGame，实现永久保留
            if (window.AiPhoneGame && typeof AiPhoneGame.saveGame === 'function') {
              AiPhoneGame.saveGame({ customAvatar: base64Url }).catch(() => {});
            }

            updateUserProfilePreview();
            showToast("📷 成功保存专属头像，以后每次进入都会自动保留！");
          };
          reader.readAsDataURL(file);
        };
      }
    }

    // 渲染选人面板 (修复每次点击重置bug，支持自由任意选择)
    function renderCharSelection() {
      const listEl = document.getElementById('char-list');
      listEl.innerHTML = '';

      const defaults = [
        { id: "npc_1", name: "阿澈", subtitle: "沉稳冷静的推演派" },
        { id: "npc_2", name: "小悠", subtitle: "元气满满的乐天派" },
        { id: "npc_3", name: "凌风", subtitle: "热血战术的大师" }
      ];

      const allOptions = [...(availableChars || [])];
      defaults.forEach(d => {
        if (!allOptions.some(c => c.name === d.name)) {
          allOptions.push(d);
        }
      });

      // 仅在首次未选择时默认勾选前 3 个
      if (!selectedCharIds || selectedCharIds.length === 0) {
        selectedCharIds = allOptions.slice(0, 3).map(c => c.id);
      }

      // 更新已选角色的计数指示
      const countEl = document.getElementById('char-count-pill');
      const startBtn = document.getElementById('btn-confirm-start');
      if (countEl) {
        countEl.innerText = `已选 ${selectedCharIds.length}/3 人`;
        countEl.style.color = selectedCharIds.length === 3 ? '#22c55e' : '#f59e0b';
      }
      if (startBtn) {
        if (selectedCharIds.length === 3) {
          startBtn.innerText = "进入对局";
          startBtn.style.opacity = "1";
          startBtn.style.pointerEvents = "auto";
        } else {
          startBtn.innerText = `请勾选满 3 人 (还差 ${3 - selectedCharIds.length} 人)`;
          startBtn.style.opacity = "0.6";
          startBtn.style.pointerEvents = "none";
        }
      }

      allOptions.forEach(char => {
        const isSelected = selectedCharIds.includes(char.id);
        const item = document.createElement('div');
        item.className = 'char-card' + (isSelected ? ' selected' : '');
        item.innerHTML = `
          ${char.avatar ? `<img src="${char.avatar}" alt="" style="width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;">` : `<div class="avatar-fallback" style="width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;background:#3b82f6;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-weight:bold;">${char.name[0]}</div>`}
          <div style="flex:1;min-width:0;text-align:left;">
            <div class="char-card-name">${char.name}</div>
            <div style="font-size:10px;color:#94a3b8;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;">${char.subtitle || (char.id.startsWith('npc_') ? '内置对手' : '小手机角色')}</div>
          </div>
        `;

        item.onclick = () => {
          if (selectedCharIds.includes(char.id)) {
            // 已选中，则取消勾选
            selectedCharIds = selectedCharIds.filter(id => id !== char.id);
          } else {
            // 未选，如果未满3人则加入；若已满3人则挤掉最早勾选的
            if (selectedCharIds.length < 3) {
              selectedCharIds.push(char.id);
            } else {
              selectedCharIds.shift();
              selectedCharIds.push(char.id);
            }
          }
          renderCharSelection();
        };

        listEl.appendChild(item);
      });
    }

    /* =========================================================
       6. 启动游戏与发牌
       ========================================================= */
    function startGame() {
      document.getElementById('modal-intro').style.display = 'none';
      document.getElementById('modal-gameover').style.display = 'none';

      // 组装 4 位玩家
      const chosenChars = [];
      selectedCharIds.forEach(id => {
        const found = (availableChars || []).find(c => c.id === id) || { id, name: id.startsWith('npc') ? (id === 'npc_1' ? '阿澈' : id === 'npc_2' ? '小悠' : '凌风') : '同伴' };
        chosenChars.push(found);
      });
      while (chosenChars.length < 3) {
        chosenChars.push({ id: "npc_" + chosenChars.length, name: "牌友" + (chosenChars.length + 1) });
      }

      GAME.players = [
        { id: "human", name: playerProfile.name, avatar: playerProfile.avatar, emojiAvatar: playerProfile.emojiAvatar, isAI: false, cards: [], uno: false },
        { id: chosenChars[0].id, name: chosenChars[0].name, avatar: chosenChars[0].avatar, isAI: true, cards: [], uno: false },
        { id: chosenChars[1].id, name: chosenChars[1].name, avatar: chosenChars[1].avatar, isAI: true, cards: [], uno: false },
        { id: chosenChars[2].id, name: chosenChars[2].name, avatar: chosenChars[2].avatar, isAI: true, cards: [], uno: false }
      ];

      // 设置席位 UI 名字与头像
      updateSeatUIHeader(0, GAME.players[0], 'avatar-player-text', 'avatar-player-img', 'name-player');
      updateSeatUIHeader(1, GAME.players[1], 'avatar-left-text', 'avatar-left-img', 'name-left');
      updateSeatUIHeader(2, GAME.players[2], 'avatar-top-text', 'avatar-top-img', 'name-top');
      updateSeatUIHeader(3, GAME.players[3], 'avatar-right-text', 'avatar-right-img', 'name-right');

      // 初始化牌堆
      GAME.drawPile = createDeck();
      GAME.discardPile = [];
      GAME.direction = 1;
      // 随机抽取首位出牌玩家 (0: 我, 1: 左家, 2: 对家, 3: 右家)
      GAME.currentTurn = Math.floor(Math.random() * 4);
      GAME.playerUnoShouted = false;
      GAME.hasDrawnThisTurn = false;
      GAME.gameActive = true;

      // 发牌：每人 7 张并按颜色理牌
      for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
        GAME.players.forEach(p => p.cards.push(GAME.drawPile.pop()));
      }
      GAME.players.forEach(p => {
        p.cards = sortCardsByColor(p.cards);
      });

      // 起始弃牌（不能是 +4 万能牌，确保第一张正常）
      let firstCard = GAME.drawPile.pop();
      while (firstCard.type === 'wild_draw4') {
        GAME.drawPile.unshift(firstCard);
        firstCard = GAME.drawPile.pop();
      }
      GAME.discardPile.push(firstCard);
      GAME.currentColor = firstCard.color === 'black' ? COLORS[Math.floor(Math.random() * 4)] : firstCard.color;

      playSound('draw');

      const starterName = GAME.currentTurn === 0 ? "你" : `【${GAME.players[GAME.currentTurn].name}】`;
      showToast(`🎲 随机先手：本局由 ${starterName} 先出牌！底牌是【${getCardDesc(firstCard)}】`);

      renderBoard();
      triggerTurn();
    }

    /* =========================================================
       7. 牌面渲染与卡牌判断
       ========================================================= */
    function getCardDesc(card) {
      const colorNames = { red: "红", yellow: "黄", green: "绿", blue: "蓝", black: "万能" };
      const valNames = { skip: "跳过", reverse: "转向", draw2: "+2", wild: "变色", wild_draw4: "+4" };
      return `${colorNames[card.color] || ""}${valNames[card.value] !== undefined ? valNames[card.value] : card.value}`;
    }

    function canPlayCard(card) {
      const topCard = GAME.discardPile[GAME.discardPile.length - 1];
      if (!topCard) return true;

      // 黑色万能牌随时可出
      if (card.color === 'black') return true;

      // 颜色匹配当前指定颜色
      if (card.color === GAME.currentColor) return true;

      // 同数值或同功能匹配
      if (card.type === topCard.type && card.type !== 'number') return true;
      if (card.type === 'number' && topCard.type === 'number' && card.value === topCard.value) return true;

      return false;
    }

    function renderCardHTML(card, isPlayable = false, onClickStr = '') {
      let bgClass = 'color-' + card.color;
      let displayValue = card.value;
      if (card.type === 'skip') displayValue = '⊘';
      if (card.type === 'reverse') displayValue = '⇄';
      if (card.type === 'draw2') displayValue = '+2';
      if (card.type === 'wild') displayValue = '🌈';
      if (card.type === 'wild_draw4') displayValue = '+4';

      return `
        <div class="uno-card ${isPlayable ? 'playable' : 'disabled'}" ${onClickStr}>
          <div class="card-inner ${bgClass}">
            <div class="card-oval"></div>
            <div class="card-corner tl">${displayValue}</div>
            <div class="card-num">${displayValue}</div>
            <div class="card-corner br">${displayValue}</div>
          </div>
        </div>
      `;
    }

    function renderBoard() {
      // 1. 渲染弃牌堆顶牌
      const topCard = GAME.discardPile[GAME.discardPile.length - 1];
      const discardEl = document.getElementById('discard-pile');
      if (topCard) {
        discardEl.innerHTML = renderCardHTML(topCard, false);
      }

      // 2. 渲染中央当前颜色与摸牌堆
      document.getElementById('deck-count-text').innerText = GAME.drawPile.length;
      const glow = document.getElementById('color-glow');
      glow.className = `active-color-glow color-${GAME.currentColor}`;

      // 3. 转向指示器
      const ring = document.getElementById('direction-ring');
      if (GAME.direction === -1) {
        ring.classList.add('reverse');
      } else {
        ring.classList.remove('reverse');
      }

      // 4. 玩家席位高亮与手牌数
      const seatIds = ['seat-player', 'seat-left', 'seat-top', 'seat-right'];
      const countIds = ['count-player', 'count-left', 'count-top', 'count-right'];
      const unoIds = ['uno-badge-player', 'uno-badge-left', 'uno-badge-top', 'uno-badge-right'];

      GAME.players.forEach((p, idx) => {
        const seatEl = document.getElementById(seatIds[idx]);
        if (seatEl) {
          if (idx === GAME.currentTurn) {
            seatEl.classList.add('active-turn');
          } else {
            seatEl.classList.remove('active-turn');
          }
        }
        document.getElementById(countIds[idx]).innerText = p.cards.length;
        document.getElementById(unoIds[idx]).style.display = p.cards.length === 1 ? 'block' : 'none';
      });

      // 5. 渲染玩家手牌 (自适应动态重叠算法与角标保护)
      const handContainer = document.getElementById('player-cards');
      handContainer.innerHTML = '';
      const isMyTurn = (GAME.currentTurn === 0 && GAME.gameActive);
      const myCards = GAME.players[0].cards;
      const totalCards = myCards.length;

      // 动态计算重叠负边距：牌越多挤得越紧，但最大程度保留左上角标
      let cardMarginRight = -24;
      if (totalCards > 16) {
        cardMarginRight = -50;
      } else if (totalCards > 12) {
        cardMarginRight = -44;
      } else if (totalCards > 8) {
        cardMarginRight = -36;
      } else if (totalCards > 5) {
        cardMarginRight = -28;
      }

      myCards.forEach((card, idx) => {
        const playable = isMyTurn && canPlayCard(card);
        const cardWrapper = document.createElement('div');
        cardWrapper.className = 'card-wrapper';
        // 左侧牌置于上层，避免右侧卡牌遮挡左上角的颜色与数字
        cardWrapper.style.zIndex = (totalCards + 20 - idx);
        if (idx !== totalCards - 1) {
          cardWrapper.style.marginRight = cardMarginRight + 'px';
        }
        cardWrapper.innerHTML = renderCardHTML(card, playable);

        if (playable) {
          cardWrapper.onclick = () => playerPlayCard(card);
        }

        // 移动端轻触预览高亮反馈
        cardWrapper.addEventListener('touchstart', () => {
          document.querySelectorAll('.card-wrapper.touch-active').forEach(w => w.classList.remove('touch-active'));
          cardWrapper.classList.add('touch-active');
        }, { passive: true });

        handContainer.appendChild(cardWrapper);
      });

      // 6. 按钮状态控制
      const passBtn = document.getElementById('btn-pass-turn');
      passBtn.style.display = (isMyTurn && GAME.hasDrawnThisTurn) ? 'block' : 'none';

      const unoBtn = document.getElementById('btn-uno-shout');
      if (GAME.players[0].cards.length === 2 && isMyTurn && !GAME.playerUnoShouted) {
        unoBtn.classList.add('highlight');
      } else {
        unoBtn.classList.remove('highlight');
      }
    }

    /* =========================================================
       8. 回合驱动与规则结算 (彻底杜绝递归死锁与卡住)
       ========================================================= */
    function triggerTurn() {
      if (!GAME.gameActive) return;
      GAME.hasDrawnThisTurn = false;
      renderBoard();

      const curIndex = GAME.currentTurn;
      const curPlayer = GAME.players[curIndex];

      if (curIndex === 0) {
        // 真人玩家回合
        showToast("轮到你出牌了！");
      } else {
        // AI 回合：通过宏任务分离，彻底切断调用栈，绝不出现卡死无反应
        showToast(`轮到【${curPlayer.name}】出牌…`);
        setTimeout(() => {
          if (!GAME.gameActive || GAME.currentTurn !== curIndex) return;
          handleAITurn(curIndex);
        }, getDelay(1000));
      }
    }

    function advanceTurn(skipSteps = 1) {
      if (!GAME.gameActive) return;
      const total = GAME.players.length;
      GAME.currentTurn = (GAME.currentTurn + GAME.direction * skipSteps + total * 10) % total;
      renderBoard();
      // 彻底解耦异步调用栈，杜绝锁死问题
      setTimeout(() => {
        triggerTurn();
      }, getDelay(450));
    }

    // 从牌堆摸牌
    function drawCardForPlayer(playerIndex, count = 1) {
      const cardsDrawn = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        if (GAME.drawPile.length === 0) {
          // 洗牌补充摸牌堆 (保留顶牌)
          if (GAME.discardPile.length <= 1) break;
          const topCard = GAME.discardPile.pop();
          GAME.drawPile = [...GAME.discardPile];
          GAME.discardPile = [topCard];
          for (let k = GAME.drawPile.length - 1; k > 0; k--) {
            const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (k + 1));
            [GAME.drawPile[k], GAME.drawPile[j]] = [GAME.drawPile[j], GAME.drawPile[k]];
          }
          showToast("牌堆已重新洗匀");
        }
        const card = GAME.drawPile.pop();
        if (card) {
          GAME.players[playerIndex].cards.push(card);
          cardsDrawn.push(card);
        }
      }
      // 摸牌后自动理牌：同色归拢排列
      GAME.players[playerIndex].cards = sortCardsByColor(GAME.players[playerIndex].cards);
      playSound('draw');
      return cardsDrawn;
    }

    // 统一出牌应用效果 (节奏张弛有度、支持大模型连贯互动)
    async function applyCardEffect(playerIndex, card, chosenColor = null) {
      const p = GAME.players[playerIndex];
      const prevColor = GAME.currentColor;
      const colorNames = { red: "红", yellow: "黄", green: "绿", blue: "蓝" };

      // 判定出牌者在打出这张牌前，手中是否有与牌堆顶同色的牌 (判定+4是否合法)
      const hadMatchingColorBefore = p.cards.some(c => c.color === prevColor && c.id !== card.id);

      const cardIdx = p.cards.findIndex(c => c.id === card.id);
      if (cardIdx !== -1) p.cards.splice(cardIdx, 1);
      // 出牌后自动重新理牌
      p.cards = sortCardsByColor(p.cards);

      GAME.discardPile.push(card);
      playSound('play');

      // 更新当前有效颜色
      if (card.color === 'black') {
        GAME.currentColor = chosenColor || COLORS[Math.floor(Math.random() * 4)];
      } else {
        GAME.currentColor = card.color;
      }

      // UNO 判定与触发
      if (p.cards.length === 1) {
        p.uno = true;
        playSound('uno');
        await aiSpeak(playerIndex, "我只剩最后一张牌了，大喊一声 UNO！向全场宣告绝杀时刻！");
        showToast(`⚠️ 警报！${p.name} 仅剩最后 1 张手牌并喊了 UNO!`);
        await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, getDelay(1200)));
      } else {
        p.uno = false;
      }

      // 胜利检查
      if (p.cards.length === 0) {
        renderBoard();
        handleGameOver(playerIndex);
        return;
      }

      // +4 牌专门进入质疑裁决流程 (Challenge)
      if (card.type === 'wild_draw4') {
        const targetIdx = (playerIndex + GAME.direction + 4) % 4;
        renderBoard();
        await handleWild4Challenge(playerIndex, targetIdx, hadMatchingColorBefore, GAME.currentColor, prevColor);
        return;
      }

      // 特殊牌功能结算与连贯互动
      let nextSkip = 1;

      if (card.type === 'reverse') {
        GAME.direction *= -1;
        showToast(`🔄 ${p.name} 打出【转向】，出牌方向逆转！`);
        renderBoard();
        await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, getDelay(2000)));

      } else if (card.type === 'skip') {
        nextSkip = 2;
        const targetIdx = (playerIndex + GAME.direction + 4) % 4;
        const target = GAME.players[targetIdx];
        showToast(`🚫 ${p.name} 打出【跳过】！${target.name} 被暂停本轮！`);
        renderBoard();
        await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, getDelay(1200)));

        // 受害者大模型互动台词
        await aiSpeak(targetIdx, `我被【${p.name}】的跳过牌击中，被迫轮空一轮，很不甘心。`);
        await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, getDelay(2200)));

      } else if (card.type === 'draw2') {
        nextSkip = 2;
        const targetIdx = (playerIndex + GAME.direction + 4) % 4;
        const target = GAME.players[targetIdx];
        drawCardForPlayer(targetIdx, 2);
        showToast(`💥 ${p.name} 打出【+2】！${target.name} 罚摸 2 张并被跳过！`);
        renderBoard();
        await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, getDelay(1200)));

        // 受害者大模型互动台词
        await aiSpeak(targetIdx, `我被【${p.name}】打出的+2命中，被迫摸了2张牌并被跳过，十分痛苦。`);
        await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, getDelay(2400)));

      } else if (card.type === 'wild') {

    // 沉浸慢节奏桌游驱动：思考 ➔ 吐露心声(给足阅读时间) ➔ 落牌 ➔ 观察桌局
    async function handleAITurn(aiIndex) {
      const ai = GAME.players[aiIndex];

      // 1. 模拟真人看牌挑选阶段（1.4 秒凝神期）
      showSpeech(aiIndex, "正在选牌…");
      await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, getDelay(1300)));
      if (!GAME.gameActive) return;

      // 2. 寻找所有合法手牌
      const validCards = ai.cards.filter(c => canPlayCard(c));

      if (validCards.length > 0) {
        // 策略排序：功能牌优先，同色其次，万能最后
        validCards.sort((a, b) => {
          const score = c => (c.type === 'wild_draw4' ? 10 : c.type === 'draw2' ? 8 : c.type === 'skip' ? 7 : c.type === 'reverse' ? 6 : c.type === 'wild' ? 5 : 2);
          return score(b) - score(a);
        });

        const chosenCard = validCards[0];
        let chosenColor = null;

        if (chosenCard.color === 'black') {
          const counts = { red: 0, yellow: 0, green: 0, blue: 0 };
          ai.cards.forEach(c => { if (counts[c.color] !== undefined) counts[c.color]++; });
          chosenColor = Object.keys(counts).reduce((a, b) => counts[a] > counts[b] ? a : b);
        }

        const colorNames = { red: "红", yellow: "黄", green: "绿", blue: "蓝" };
        const cardDesc = getCardDesc(chosenCard);
        const targetIdx = (GAME.players.indexOf(ai) + GAME.direction + 4) % 4;
        const targetPlayer = GAME.players[targetIdx];

        // 3. 像斗地主一样唤起大模型生成台词
        await aiSpeak(aiIndex, `打出了一张【${cardDesc}】${chosenCard.color === 'black' ? `(指定为${colorNames[chosenColor]}色)` : ''}，下家是【${targetPlayer.name}】`);

        // 4. 台词展出后，足足留出 2.2 秒让玩家看清发言与互动！
        await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, getDelay(2000)));
        if (!GAME.gameActive) return;

        // 5. 正式落牌，严格 await 其动画与观察流程！
        await applyCardEffect(aiIndex, chosenCard, chosenColor);

      } else {
        // 无牌可出时的动作
        await aiSpeak(aiIndex, `手里没有合规的牌，摸一张`);
        await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, getDelay(1600)));
        if (!GAME.gameActive) return;

        const drawn = drawCardForPlayer(aiIndex, 1);
        renderBoard();

        if (drawn.length > 0 && canPlayCard(drawn[0])) {
          await aiSpeak(aiIndex, `运气真好，刚摸到的【${getCardDesc(drawn[0])}】正好能打出`);
          await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, getDelay(1800)));
          if (!GAME.gameActive) return;

          let chosenColor = null;
          if (drawn[0].color === 'black') chosenColor = COLORS[Math.floor(Math.random() * 4)];
          await applyCardEffect(aiIndex, drawn[0], chosenColor);
        } else {
          await aiSpeak(aiIndex, `摸了依然没有能出的牌，过牌给下家`);
          await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, getDelay(1400)));
          advanceTurn(1);
        }
      }
    }

          const contextPrompts = {
            "🌹": `玩家【${playerProfile.name}】在牌桌上向你送出了一朵红玫瑰【🌹】表达好感与感谢`,
            "😡": `玩家【${playerProfile.name}】在牌桌上向你扔出了愤怒表情【😡】表达被针对的抓狂不满`,
            "👍": `玩家【${playerProfile.name}】在牌桌上给你竖起了大拇指【👍】赞赏你的牌技`,
            "💣": `玩家【${playerProfile.name}】在牌桌上向你扔了一颗炸弹【💣】挑衅下战书`,
            "😭": `玩家【${playerProfile.name}】在牌桌上向你发出了大哭表情【😭】求你手下留情`
          };

          await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 200));
          await aiSpeak(targetSeat, contextPrompts[emoji]);
        };
      });
    }

    // 播放头像上炸开的表情动效
    function triggerBurstEmoji(seatIndex, emoji) {
      const seatIds = ['seat-player', 'seat-left', 'seat-top', 'seat-right'];
      const seatEl = document.getElementById(seatIds[seatIndex]);
      if (!seatEl) return;
      const avWrapper = seatEl.querySelector('.avatar-wrapper');
      if (!avWrapper) return;

      const burst = document.createElement('div');
      burst.className = 'burst-emoji';
      burst.innerText = emoji;
      avWrapper.appendChild(burst);

      setTimeout(() => {
        if (burst && burst.parentNode) burst.parentNode.removeChild(burst);
      }, 1300);
    }

    const changeCharsBtn = document.getElementById('btn-change-chars');
    if (changeCharsBtn) {
      changeCharsBtn.onclick = () => {
        document.getElementById('modal-gameover').style.display = 'none';
        document.getElementById('modal-intro').style.display = 'flex';
        renderCharSelection();
      };
    }

    const speedBtn = document.getElementById('btn-speed-toggle');
    if (speedBtn) {
      speedBtn.onclick = () => {
        if (GAME.gameSpeed === 'immersive') {
          GAME.gameSpeed = 'fast';
          speedBtn.innerText = '⚡ 节奏: 快速推进';
          speedBtn.style.color = '#38bdf8';
          showToast('已切换为【快速节奏】');
        } else {
          GAME.gameSpeed = 'immersive';
          speedBtn.innerText = '💬 节奏: 互动沉浸';
          speedBtn.style.color = '#cbd5e1';
          showToast('已切换为【互动沉浸节奏】');
        }
      };
    }

    // 页面启动装载
    window.addEventListener('load', () => {
      initHostServices();
      bindSeatInteractions();
    });
  </script>
</body>
</html>
